name: Desk
author: Fred Nix & Larry
description: Replaces the wallpaper with a live, clickable AI control room: running Claude Code / Codex / Grok / Gemini / opencode / Ollama sessions, a 7-day activity heatmap, subscription usage, recent prompts, and a machine-stats corner (CPU, RAM, disk, Wi-Fi speed, Cloudflare latency, GPU, battery). Theme-driven; SUPER summon via overlay.
